lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: High-luminance circular clusters organized in a grid-like matrix posterior to the gill slits, with approximately 4-5 visible vertical columns and 3-4 horizontal rows within the central flank region.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical pixel intensity maxima visible as columns that intersect with the horizontal rows of circular blobs, creating nodes of peak luminance at the intersections.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Primary longitudinal ridge visible on the upper flank, displaying a sharp step-function intensity gradient from high luminance (dorsal) to low luminance (ventral).

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: 8-12 high-luminance pixel clusters bounded within the first dorsal fin silhouette, showing a non-uniform spatial arrangement concentrated toward the posterior margin.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Small notch-like loss of pixel continuity on the posterior trailing edge of the first dorsal fin; subtle depigmentation or scarring visible on the lower posterior flank.
other_distinctive_markers: Elongated high-contrast feature (remora) attached to the lower lateral flank, oriented parallel to the host's longitudinal axis.
